items.title: BlackRock Pushing For New 'ETIF' Hybrid
items.summary: Bloomberg's Vildana Hajric joins Isabelle Lee and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." BlackRock is pushing to redraw the boundaries of the $16 trillion US exchange-traded funds industry with a novel investment vehicle that would marry two of Wall Street's biggest obsessions: the trading ease of ETFs and the allure of private markets.

items.title: BlackRock Seeks to Break ETF Mold With Private-Market Hybrid
items.summary: BlackRock is seeking approval for an exchange-traded interval fund, or ETIF, that would allow investors to trade shares throughout the day while giving managers greater latitude to hold private assets.

items.title: 390-year-old Ivy League university quietly hoards Bitcoin and gold
items.summary: An Ivy League University held onto $144 million in Bitcoin and boosted its gold bet nearly 20-fold, new SEC filings show.

items.title: “The Biggest Competition For Capital I Have Seen in 50 years in Finance,” Larry Fink Sounds The Alarm As Public Worldwide Debt Hits $110 Trillion, While $13 Trillion Of Corporate Debt Must Be Refinanced In The Next 5 Years
items.summary: Governments are borrowing at record pace just as tech giants race to fund AI, and the collision is already pushing mortgage rates higher. Some deals are being shelved and one developer simply walked away, so who gets squeezed next?

items.title: BlackRock Shifts AI Bets, Adds Equity Risk in New Model Shakeup
items.summary: BlackRock Inc. is reshuffling its artificial intelligence exposure and tactically adding equity risk following a market selloff, in the latest overhaul of its $300 billion suite of model portfolios.

items.title: 2 Safe S&P 500 Financial Dividend Stocks Boomers Can Buy and Hold Forever
items.summary: In 2009, one of America's strongest banks slashed its dividend to a nickel, and retirees still remember the sting. Two financial giants have since rebuilt their payouts on very different foundations, yet each carries a risk that could test the promise.
